title: Dream of Sadat's assassination as it happened

tellings.quote: specific in my case cuz my first dream, which I chronicle in the book, was Sadat's assassination September 6, 1981, where I was in I was there.

plain: A former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen says that in 1981, while he was at Fort Bliss, an army base in Texas, he dreamed of the killing of Anwar Sadat, the president of Egypt, in Cairo, at the time it happened, and felt as if he was there. He says it was his first such dream and that he describes it in his book, A State of Mind: Faith in the CIA. If true, it would mean the mind can see distant events as they unfold.
